gloss: to start up; to boot; to launch (a machine or program)

definitions.gloss: to start up; to boot; to launch (a machine or program)
definitions.explanation: To turn on or activate a computer, application, machine, or system so that it begins operating. The standard term for booting a computer or launching software.

examples.japanese: パソコンを{起動|きどう}する。
アプリを{起動|きどう}したが、{画面|がめん}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}のままだ。
examples.english: I launched the app, but the screen stayed blank.

examples.japanese: パソコンが{正常|せいじょう}に{起動|きどう}しない{場合|ばあい}は、{電源|でんげん}を{切|き}って{数分|すうふん}{待|ま}ってからもう{一度|いちど}{試|ため}してください。
examples.english: If the computer does not start up normally, turn off the power, wait a few minutes, and try again.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both transitively (パソコンを{起動|きどう}する 'start up the computer') and intransitively (パソコンが{起動|きどう}する 'the computer starts up'). Essential vocabulary for anyone using computers or smartphones in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パソコンを{起動|きどう}する (boot a computer)
- アプリを{起動|きどう}する (launch an app)
- {起動|きどう}{時間|じかん} (startup time)
- {起動|きどう}{画面|がめん} (startup screen)
- {再|さい}{起動|きどう}する (restart/reboot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立|た}ち{上|あ}げる: to start up/launch — more colloquial synonym
- {再|さい}{起動|きどう}する: to restart/reboot — very commonly used for troubleshooting
